company.name: VoyShip
company.shortDescription: Voyship platform aims to connect shoppers who want to get shipment(s) locally or internationally with local or international travelers
company.description: Voyship is a platform which includes a website and mobile application available for Android as well as IOS. Voyship platform aims to connect shoppers or people who want to get item(s) or shipment(s) locally or internationally with local or international travelers who can collect and transport these items or shipments. Voship also provides a prime service to facilitate purchasing and shipping process through travelers. All our services are based on direct contact among travelers and shoppers without any direct responsibility or interfering from our side, we also strongly assure that our platform is not a shipping, logistics or courier company; we are just a plat form that connects travelers with shoppers.
